awards.title: The Clearance Rack King
awards.blurb: Landed the two biggest steals of the entire draft: Matthew Stafford fell to pick 159 (ADP 107.0, +52.0) and Dalton Kincaid to pick 154 (ADP 104.7, +49.3). Nobody else got two players this far below market.

awards.title: Couldn't Wait Till Round 14
awards.blurb: Biggest real reach of the night (excluding the last two dart-throw rounds): Jordan James, RB, taken in round 13 at pick 146 - 75 picks ahead of his ADP of 221.0.

awards.title: The One-Hit Wonder
awards.blurb: Built the single best QB room in the entire league - Josh Allen graded an A+, tops in the league at the position. Somehow still walked away with the 2nd-worst overall grade (D-).

awards.title: Ravens Superfan (Literally Drafted the Coach)
awards.blurb: The only manager to go 3-for-1 on a single NFL team: Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, and the Baltimore Ravens' own Head Coach, all on one roster.

awards.title: The Iceberg
awards.blurb: Most of the value is below the surface: the league's best TE (Trey McBride, A+ grade) and, separately, the deepest bench in the entire league (A+, 1,012 projected bench points).

awards.title: Backup Plan, MVP Price
awards.blurb: Snuck a top-5 steal of the whole draft at backup QB: Bo Nix fell to pick 147 against an ADP of 106.3 - a 40.7-pick discount on a QB2 nobody was fighting for.

awards.title: The Technicality Award
awards.blurb: Made the single largest reach of the entire night - Caleb Douglas, 86 picks ahead of his ADP - but it happened on literally the last pick of the draft (#180), so it doesn't count for the official reach title.

awards.title: One Bright Spot in a Rough Night
awards.blurb: The lone highlight of an otherwise tough draft: a top-10 steal at TE, grabbing Harold Fannin Jr. 28.7 picks after his ADP.

awards.title: Coach of the Year (Fantasy Division)
awards.blurb: Drafted the single best-graded Head Coach in the entire league (A+) - the rest of the roster was up and down, but nobody beat this coaching hire.

awards.title: Zero-RB Zealot
awards.blurb: Opened the draft with three straight wide receivers - Ja'Marr Chase, Drake London, and Nico Collins - before touching a running back. The only team to open on a 3-peat at receiver.

awards.title: Ground and Pound
awards.blurb: Went the exact opposite direction of Prodahl: three straight running backs to open the draft - Jonathan Taylor, Jeremiyah Love, and Javonte Williams.

awards.title: Paid Full Retail All Night
awards.blurb: Never found a real discount anywhere in 15 rounds - the single best value pick on the whole roster was a measly +5.3 picks (Cam Skattebo), the smallest personal-best margin of anyone in the league. Paired with the league's lowest overall grade.
